# MelonPatch

> MelonPatch is an indie software studio that builds AI-powered tools and experiences. Founded in 2026, the studio operates remote-first with a philosophy of intentional, human-centered software design. Tagline: "Cultivating Products for the You of Today."

## Products

- [MelonReader](https://melonpatch.dev/melonreader/): An iOS ebook reader designed for language learners. Bring your own TXT or EPUB files in any language, or start from a curated public-domain library, and read with tap-to-translate that gives an instant translation in your native language — one that reads the surrounding sentence for context. Hear pronunciation, save words and phrases to a word bank organized by language, and review them with spaced-repetition flashcards. Local-first and private: books and saved words stay on the device, with no account required. Free to start; MelonReader Plus unlocks unlimited imported books. Status: Coming Soon.

## FAQ

### What is MelonPatch?
MelonPatch is an indie software studio that builds AI-powered tools and experiences. Founded in 2026, the studio's philosophy is to ship small, iterate fast, and care deeply about the people who use their products.

### What is MelonReader?
MelonReader is an iOS app for language learners. It supports EPUB and TXT formats. Bring your own books in any language (or start from a curated public-domain library), tap words or phrases for an instant translation in your native language that reads the surrounding sentence for context, hear pronunciation, and save words to flashcard decks organized by language for spaced-repetition review. It is local-first and private: books and saved words stay on the device.

### What file formats does MelonReader support?
EPUB and TXT. You can bring books in any language and read them with translations in your chosen native language.

### How does the flashcard feature work?
Tap any word or phrase while reading to translate it. Bookmark the translation and it gets added to your word bank. The app creates separate flashcard decks per language, using spaced repetition for review.
